parts.html: The K-41 kitchen is a modern straight kitchen: dark graphite wall cabinets over a light base. The graphite fronts have a barely visible wood texture, so the dark color does not look flat. The base cabinets, tall side sections, and the open niche on the right of the upper row are all one light shade, close to milky white.

The dark color is only in the upper row and everything else is light, so even with a graphite top the kitchen does not feel oppressive. The niche on the right is finished like the base cabinets and side sections, with no separate wood decor.
The countertop, patterned like black marble, echoes the dark top, and its light veining echoes the white fronts and backsplash. This connects the two contrasting rows without extra decor.
This kitchen suits a minimalist interior in an apartment or a house, including an open-plan kitchen and living room where the furniture is visible from the whole room.
Dimensions and appliance layout
The kitchen is straight, 4.2 linear meters along one wall. This run includes the work surface, wall and base cabinets, tall side sections, and spaces for built-in appliances.
Overall dimensions of the standard model: 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

In the visualization, a built-in oven sits on the left in a tall light-colored unit, the work surface with the cooktop and sink is in the center, and another tall light-colored unit is on the right. The open niche in the upper row holds dishes and everyday items.
The standard K-41 has no island.
Fronts, carcass, countertop

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard, but their finishes differ: the closed upper cabinets are a very dark graphite with a wood texture, while the lower cabinets and tall side sections have a light solid-color decor.
The carcass is 18 mm laminated chipboard.
The countertop is chipboard-based with a dark black marble-look decor and light veining. This is a surface finish: natural marble is not included in the standard configuration.
The backsplash is light, matching the base cabinets. A black faucet and the built-in oven add dark details and support the contrast.
Appliances, cargo pull-out, and hardware
The K-41 is designed for built-in appliances: we agree on the set of appliances and their placement during the design stage. The appliances themselves are not included in the furniture price.
A cargo pull-out is part of the standard configuration — one more pull-out compartment for food and small kitchen items.
The hinged fronts hang on Hettich soft-close hinges. The drawers run on Quadro Hettich concealed undermount slides: they sit under the drawer bottom and cannot be seen when the drawer is open.
Handles are included; there are no lift-up mechanisms.
K-41 kitchen technical specifications — standard configuration
Color: Gray; as shown in the visualization, a dark graphite top and a light bottom.
Style: Modern.
Layout: Straight.
Countertop type: Chipboard-based.
Countertop decor: Dark, black marble look.
Overall dimensions: 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.
Lift-up mechanism: No.
Appliance installation type: Built-in.
Cargo pull-out: Yes.
Handles: Included.
Upper fronts: Laminated chipboard, dark graphite decor with wood texture.
Lower fronts: Laminated chipboard, light solid-color decor.
Carcass: Laminated chipboard, 18 mm.
Length: 4.2 linear m.
Island: No.
Hinges: Hettich with soft-close mechanism.
Decor: Combination — dark graphite upper cabinets and light lower fronts.
Slides: Concealed Quadro Hettich.

Additional features shown in the visualization: The tall side sections and the open niche on the right in the upper row are finished in the same light shade as the lower cabinets; light backsplash, dark marble-look countertop, and a built-in oven on the left.
To your dimensions, the K-41 can be made in other shades of graphite and light, with a different countertop and hardware, and in materials that cost less or more than the standard ones.
